code_hints: After navigation, if location.pathname is '/' or '/en-de', immediately navigate to the fallback PLP '/en-de/men/ready-to-wear/'.
Before waiting for PLP tiles, attempt to click the cookie banner: await page.locator('#onetrust-accept-btn-handler').click({ timeout: 3000 }).catch(() => {});
If a geo/locale modal is present, click a button containing 'Continue' before proceeding.
Wait for one of the PLP grid selectors (container or product_card). If none appear, perform lazy scroll rounds; re-check after each scroll.
If no tiles after scroll and you are still on homepage, re-navigate to the fallback PLP once.
When extracting links, restrict to anchors containing '/products/' to avoid editorial links.
rationale: The crawl landed on the locale homepage (en-de) and found no product tiles, indicating the original PLP path likely redirected. Moncler commonly shows a OneTrust cookie banner and sometimes a locale gate that blocks rendering. We add robust modal selectors, enforce a stable locale and a known PLP path, and provide broader yet constrained PLP/PDP selectors observed across their SFCC-based frontend. URL rules normalize to the retail domain, force the en-de locale, and rewrite the failing path to a canonical category. Minimal lazy-load handling improves odds of rendering product tiles.

plp.product_card: a[data-testid*='product-tile'], article[data-testid*='product-tile'], li[data-testid='product-grid-item'] a, li.product-grid__item a
